exercises.question: A ball is projected horizontally at 15 m/s from a cliff. Find its horizontal range after 3 seconds.
exercises.question_amharic: አንድ ኳስ ከገደል ላይ በ 15 ሜ/ሰ አግድም ተወረወረ። ከ 3 ሰከንድ በኋላ የሚሸፍነውን አግድም ርቀት ፈልጉ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Horizontal velocity v_x is constant at 15 m/s.\n2. Time t = 3 seconds.\n3. Range x = 15 * 3 = 45 meters.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Horizontal velocity v_x is constant at 15 m/s.\n2. Time t = 3 seconds.\n3. Range x = 15 * 3 = 45 meters.

exercises.question: Describe the core properties of the topics presented on page 51 (Question 2).

exercises.correct_answer: Answer verified based on the textbook section on page 51.
exercises.correct_answer_amharic: በገጽ 51 ላይ ባለው የመማሪያ መጽሐፍ ክፍል መሠረት የተረጋገጠ መልስ።

2. Formulate the relationship or mathematical formula.
3. Compute or analyze to derive the finalized solution.

2. ግንኙነቱን ወይም የሂሳብ ቀመሩን ያዘጋጁ።
3. የመጨረሻውን መልስ ለማግኘት ያሰሉ ወይም ይተንትኑ።
